variants.title: Seebeck coefficient of doped n-type silicon
variants.method: differential steady-state and quasi-static slope at 300 K
variants.note: Electrons: a negative coefficient. Degenerately doped silicon has a power factor of a few mW/(m K^2) but a high thermal conductivity, so ZT stays small. S and rho illustrative of that doping - verify.

source.title: L. Weber and E. Gmelin, Appl. Phys. A 53, 136 (1991): transport in doped silicon
